content: The summary draft is based on the sequence-to-sequence model. On the encoder side the input document $X$ is encoded into representation vectors $H = \lbrace h_1, \ldots , h_m\rbrace $ , and then fed to the decoder to generate the summary draft $A = \lbrace a_1, \ldots , a_{|a|}\rbrace $ .
